fusions.name: Ringing Bark
fusions.desc: Barks a ringing pulse that hits the first enemy for 4 resonating damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bite From the Dark
fusions.desc: Bites with your weapon for 26 dark damage that is always a critical hit and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dusk Prowl
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Moonless Chase
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance.
